whyItMatters: A committed GitHub token grants its scopes to anyone with repository access and keeps working until revoked.
actions: Revoke the token immediately in GitHub settings and confirm revocation.
Review the audit log for actions the token performed and remediate misuse.
Issue a new fine-grained token with minimal scopes and store it in a secret manager; never commit it.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and the old token no longer authenticates.
